description.text: Teaching Objective To cultivate senior applied Stomatology talents with strong hands-on skills, entrepreneurial ability, and strong ability to develop. To cultivate Doctors for diagnosis and treatment of stomatological disease. Main courses Biochemistry, Physiology, Medical Immunology, medical microbiology, Experiment of medical functional science, Pathology, pharmacology, clinical diagnostics, oral anatomical physiology, oral histology and pathology, internal medicine, surgery, Cariology And Endodontics, Periodontics, oral mucosal disease study, oral and maxillofacial surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics, prevention of oral medicine. Graduates acquire following knowledge and ability 1.Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills of preclinical medicine and clinical medicine 2.Basic theoretical knowledge and clinical operational skills of various disciplines of Stomatology; 3.Dentistry common disease diagnosis, treatment and initial processing of urgent, difficult, severe symptom; 4.A basic knowledge of dental work and general skills; 5.Mastering medical literature search, the basic method of data survey, with initial capacity of oral medical research. Internship and Employment A total of 3,541 graduates of our school graduate in 2012, of which a total of 42 graduates of doctoral students, graduate students were 883 (including 27 foreign students, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan regions student 4), a total of 191 seven-year Accelerated Degree Graduation students, 2425 of undergraduate and the specialist graduates (including 825 Zhongshan College graduates). There are more than 90 graduates from the Stomatology employed by hospital in different provinces.

duration.text: The Stomatology at Shenyang Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Applicants must Be in good health. 3. High school graduate or equivalent or above.
